column6: 他にご用件はあり{08:15}\n
column7: Can I get you anything else?\n
column8: reads: 他にご用件はありますか？\n @from-v005

column6: いらっしゃいませ。ご用件をどうぞ。\n
column7: Welcome. How can I help you?\n
column8: @from-v005

column6: どれも良い品{08:55}よ。ゆっくり見てい{08:52}下{08:49}。\n
column7: Here's what we have on offer.\nPlease take a look.\n
column8: reads: どれも良い品ですよ。ゆっくり見ていって下さい。\n @from-v005

column7: Apologies, but it doesn't look like you have\nanything that we'd be interested in buying.\n
column8: reads: うちで扱ってる物をお持ちでないみたいですが。\n @from-v005

column6: どれを買い取ればよろしいんで？\n
column7: What would you like to sell?\n
column8: @from-v005

column7: Umm... It doesn't look like you have enough money.\n
column8: reads: ‥‥あの、お金が足りないようですが？\n @from-v005

column6: お買い上げの品はこちらでよろしい{08:55}ね？\n
column7: Please confirm these items.\n
column8: reads: お買い上げの品はこちらでよろしいですね？\n @from-v005

column6: そん{08:58}持ち切れませんよ。\n
column7: That is more than you are able to carry.\n
column8: reads: そんなに持ち切れませんよ。\n @from-v005

column6: いくらなん{08:56}そこまで安くはできませんよ。\n
column7: I'm sorry, but that is lower than I am able to go.\n
column8: reads: いくらなんでもそこまで安くはできませんよ。\n @from-v005

column6: うーん、その値ではねえ‥‥。せめて、{08:47}くらいはね。\n
column7: Umm, that is a little... How about this?\n
column8: reads: うーん、その値ではねえ‥‥。せめて、このくらいはね。\n @from-v005

column6: いいでしょう！ お売りし{08:5A}。\n
column7: Very well. It is a deal.\n
column8: reads: いいでしょう！ お売りします。\n @from-v005

column6: ありがとうござい{08:5A}。\n
column7: Thank you very much.\n
column8: reads: ありがとうございます。\n @from-v005

column6: 引き取る品はこちらでよろしい{08:55}ね？\n
column7: Are you good with these items?\n
column8: reads: 引き取る品はこちらでよろしいですね？\n @from-v005

column6: いくらなん{08:56}高すぎ{08:5A}よ。\n‥‥{08:5C}少し安くはなりませんかね？\n
column7: That is more than I am able to offer.\nCould you consider lowering the price?\n
column8: reads: いくらなんでも高すぎますよ。\n‥‥もう少し安くはなりませんかね？\n @from-v005

column6: {08:4D}じゃちょ{08:53}高い{08:55}よ。\n‥‥せめて{08:47}くらいになりませんか？\n
column7: That is a bit too high. How about this?\n
column8: reads: それじゃちょっと高いですよ。\n‥‥せめてこのくらいになりませんか？\n @from-v005

column6: ＯＫ。その値で買い取りましょう。\n
column7: Very well. It is a deal.\n
column8: @from-v005

column6: ありがとうござい{08:5A}。\n
column7: Thank you.\n
column8: reads: ありがとうございます。\n @from-v005

column6: ああ‥‥そうそう。\n
column7: Oh, yes.\n
column8: @from-v005

column6: 毎度ありー。次もごひいきに頼み{08:5A}よ。\n
column7: Thank you very much.\nWe look forward to your next visit.\n
column8: reads: 毎度ありー。次もごひいきに頼みますよ。\n @from-v005

column7: If you ever find yourself holding onto wares you no longer require,\nour doors are always open.\n
column8: reads: また要らないものがあったらお願いしますよ。\n @from-v005

column6: お客さん、ひやかしは困り{08:5A}よ。\n
column7: We do not appreciate window shoppers, thank you very much.\n
column8: reads: お客さん、ひやかしは困りますよ。\n @from-v005

column7: It's not much, but please, have this.\nMay it prove useful on your journey.\n
column8: reads: つまらない物ですがこれを差し上げます。\nお役立てください。\n @from-v005
